settings.question: When should I take this?
settings.answer: Take two capsules daily with food. Consistency matters more than timing, so pick a moment you will remember.

settings.question: How do I read the test results?
settings.answer: Every batch has a certificate of analysis linked on its product page, showing the tested amount of each active alongside heavy metal and microbial screening.

settings.question: Can I take more than one product together?
settings.answer: Yes. The range is designed to stack without overlapping doses. If you take prescription medication, speak to your GP or pharmacist first.
